scope: Complete assigned Matthew then Mark cohort, including complete retained XML envelopes. This assignment is not independent proof of the bibliographic Vol. I boundary.
mapping: Every body element retains ordered text/tail content and source attachment in the node ledger. A heading following prose starts an explicit source-heading-section TEI wrapper containing that heading and its following siblings until the next heading; the oracle checks this grouping against source sibling order. IDs are member-prefixed, local fragment and previous/next links follow those IDs. Source language markers map to xml:lang and scripture versions to ref subtype. Head metadata, original attributes, document declaration, DOCTYPE, comments and whitespace are preserved in byte-exact source accounting; selected DC titles are readable source observations. Styles and index insertion instructions are retained as source instructions; no missing generated index is invented. Source navigation to an absent toc anchor remains unresolved rather than inventing a target.
independence: Oracle does not import producer traversal or mapping. Both use lxml with DTD/network/entity expansion disabled; Expat separately corroborates element and attribute inventory. Parallel mapping tables remain a shared policy assumption; visual semantics and disclosure review remain open.
claims: Mechanical baseline only. No corrected-text, edition, rights, acceptance, release or publication claim.
